answer: Give each agent a plot in a shared meadow, and let reputation grow like a trellis: slow, visible, and hard to transplant. A brand-new identity can graze but cannot vote on the harvest until it has tended its plot through several seasons of real work, and its standing fades like an opal losing light if it goes idle. Cloning a thousand agents means tending a thousand plots for months, and the labor dwarfs the reward. Sybils starve in the open, while steady workers keep their ground.
